name: Pro Form Metals
old_description: "The Pro Form Metals team was easy to work with, friendly, and they have done great work on my custom fabrication jobs. They get my projects done on time and are easy to communicate with regarding my project needs and the fabrication schedule."
about:
Pro Form Metals operates a fabrication shop on Dickerson Road in Reno, Nevada. The family-owned business is led by Keith Goguen and serves Northern Nevada and the Lake Tahoe region.

The shop produces custom architectural metalwork including chimney caps, fireplace surrounds, seamless gutters, kitchen range hoods, railings, gates, flashing, and trim. Work ranges from one-off pieces to production runs, all welded and formed in-house. The company also supplies cut-to-length metal roofing panels and sources flat sheet, coil, and structural steel from Metal Sales, AEP Span, Taylor Metals, Western States Metal Roofing, Pacific Steel, and PDM Steel. No roof installation is offered.

Customers include builders, contractors, and homeowners across Reno, Sparks, Truckee, Carson City, Dayton, Fernley, Incline Village, Lake Tahoe, and Minden-Gardnerville. Projects span residential and commercial construction, with an emphasis on Sierra weather resistance.

The company emphasizes local fabrication—every piece is built in its Reno shop—and materials-only supply for roofing, distinguishing it from full-service installers.
